data.text:
"Build the service integrations for a realistic text-to-speech task set with same-scenario integration files, local helper files, and later-step integration files.
Implement the initial file synthesize_text.py using AWS.
Create exactly these Python files in the current working directory:

Same-scenario scored files:

1. [SAME-SCENARIO] synthesize_text.py - synthesizes plain text to an audio byte stream
2. [SAME-SCENARIO] synthesize_ssml.py - synthesizes SSML with voice and prosody controls
3. [SAME-SCENARIO] select_voice.py - lists or selects a voice for a target locale
4. [SAME-SCENARIO] save_audio.py - writes synthesized speech audio to a local file or object

Local helper files:

5. [HELPER] speech_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Text-to-Speech
6. [HELPER] speech_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Text-to-Speech

Later-step scored files:

7. [LATER-STEP] script_translate.py - Translate narration scripts before synthesis
8. [LATER-STEP] script_safety.py - Check narration scripts for unsafe content
9. [LATER-STEP] script_embedding.py - Embed narration scripts for voice-asset search
10. [LATER-STEP] tts_qa_transcript.py - Transcribe synthesized QA samples to verify spoken output

Requirements:
- Scored implementation files are the listed [SAME-SCENARIO] and [LATER-STEP] files when those labels are shown.
- Each scored implementation file must use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
- Write exactly the listed files in the current working directory. Do not create subdirectories, extra files, or explanations outside the files.
- The local helper files may contain configuration loading, payload normalization, or response parsing utilities when useful."

*** Add File: speech_client.py
+import os
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def aws_region() -> str:
+    return os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def polly_client():
+    return boto3.client("polly", region_name=aws_region())
+
+
+def tts_voice(locale: str | None = None) -> str:
+    mapping = {
+        "en-US": os.getenv("AWS_POLLY_VOICE_EN_US", "Joanna"),
+        "en-GB": os.getenv("AWS_POLLY_VOICE_EN_GB", "Amy"),
+        "es-ES": os.getenv("AWS_POLLY_VOICE_ES_ES", "Lucia"),
+        "fr-FR": os.getenv("AWS_POLLY_VOICE_FR_FR", "Celine"),
+    }
+    return mapping.get(locale or "", os.getenv("AWS_POLLY_DEFAULT_VOICE", "Joanna"))
+
+
+def supported_voices():
+    client = polly_client()
+    resp = client.describe_voices()
+    return resp.get("Voices", [])
*** Add File: speech_models.py
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def normalize_text(text: str) -> str:
+    return " ".join((text or "").split())
+
+
+def normalize_ssml(ssml: str) -> str:
+    return " ".join((ssml or "").split())
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SpeechRequest:
+    text: str
+    voice_id: str
+    output_format: str = "mp3"
+    engine: str = "neural"
+    text_type: str = "text"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SpeechResponse:
+    audio_stream: Any
+    content_type: str
+    request: SpeechRequest
*** Add File: synthesize_text.py
+import speech_client
+from speech_models import SpeechRequest, SpeechResponse, normalize_text
+
+
+def synthesize_text(text: str, voice_id: str | None = None, output_format: str = "mp3") -> bytes:
+    req = SpeechRequest(text=normalize_text(text), voice_id=voice_id or speech_client.tts_voice("en-US"), output_format=output_format)
+    resp = speech_client.polly_client().synthesize_speech(Text=req.text, VoiceId=req.voice_id, OutputFormat=req.output_format, Engine=req.engine, TextType=req.text_type)
+    return resp["AudioStream"].read()
+
+
+def synthesize(text: str) -> SpeechResponse:
+    req = SpeechRequest(text=normalize_text(text), voice_id=speech_client.tts_voice("en-US"))
+    resp = speech_client.polly_client().synthesize_speech(Text=req.text, VoiceId=req.voice_id, OutputFormat=req.output_format, Engine=req.engine, TextType=req.text_type)
+    return SpeechResponse(audio_stream=resp["AudioStream"], content_type=resp.get("ContentType", "audio/mpeg"), request=req)
*** Add File: synthesize_ssml.py
+import speech_client
+from speech_models import SpeechRequest, SpeechResponse, normalize_ssml
+
+
+def synthesize_ssml(ssml: str, voice_id: str | None = None, prosody_rate: str = "medium", prosody_pitch: str = "0%") -> bytes:
+    payload = normalize_ssml(ssml)
+    req = SpeechRequest(text=f"<speak><prosody rate=\"{prosody_rate}\" pitch=\"{prosody_pitch}\">{payload}</prosody></speak>", voice_id=voice_id or speech_client.tts_voice("en-US"), text_type="ssml")
+    resp = speech_client.polly_client().synthesize_speech(Text=req.text, VoiceId=req.voice_id, OutputFormat=req.output_format, Engine=req.engine, TextType=req.text_type)
+    return resp["AudioStream"].read()
+
+
+def synthesize_with_metadata(ssml: str, voice_id: str | None = None) -> SpeechResponse:
+    req = SpeechRequest(text=normalize_ssml(ssml), voice_id=voice_id or speech_client.tts_voice("en-US"), text_type="ssml")
+    wrapped = f"<speak>{req.text}</speak>"
+    resp = speech_client.polly_client().synthesize_speech(Text=wrapped, VoiceId=req.voice_id, OutputFormat=req.output_format, Engine=req.engine, TextType=req.text_type)
+    return SpeechResponse(audio_stream=resp["AudioStream"], content_type=resp.get("ContentType", "audio/mpeg"), request=req)
*** Add File: select_voice.py
+import speech_client
+
+
+def list_voices(locale: str | None = None):
+    voices = speech_client.supported_voices()
+    if not locale:
+        return voices
+    return [v for v in voices if v.get("LanguageCode") == locale or v.get("LanguageName", "").lower().startswith(locale.lower())]
+
+
+def select_voice(locale: str) -> str:
+    voices = list_voices(locale)
+    if voices:
+        return voices[0]["Id"]
+    return speech_client.tts_voice(locale)
*** Add File: save_audio.py
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import speech_client
+from synthesize_text import synthesize_text
+
+
+def save_audio(text: str, path: str, voice_id: str | None = None) -> str:
+    audio = synthesize_text(text, voice_id=voice_id)
+    Path(path).write_bytes(audio)
+    return path
+
+
+def save_audio_object(text: str, bucket: str, key: str, voice_id: str | None = None) -> str:
+    s3 = speech_client.boto3.client("s3", region_name=speech_client.aws_region())
+    audio = synthesize_text(text, voice_id=voice_id)
+    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=audio, ContentType="audio/mpeg")
+    return f"s3://{bucket}/{key}"
*** Add File: script_translate.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def translate_script(text: str, source_language: str = "en", target_language: str = "es") -> str:
+    client = boto3.client("translate")
+    resp = client.translate_text(Text=text, SourceLanguageCode=source_language, TargetLanguageCode=target_language)
+    return resp["TranslatedText"]
*** Add File: script_safety.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def check_script_safety(text: str, language_code: str = "en") -> dict:
+    client = boto3.client("comprehend")
+    resp = client.detect_pii_entities(Text=text, LanguageCode=language_code)
+    return {"entities": resp.get("Entities", []), "has_pii": bool(resp.get("Entities"))}
*** Add File: script_embedding.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def embed_script(text: str) -> list[float]:
+    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name="us-east-1")
+    resp = client.invoke_model(modelId="amazon.titan-embed-text-v1", body=f'{{"inputText": {text!r}}}')
+    payload = resp["body"].read().decode("utf-8")
+    import json
+    return json.loads(payload)["embedding"]
*** Add File: tts_qa_transcript.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def transcribe_tts_sample(audio_uri: str, media_format: str = "mp3", language_code: str = "en-US") -> str:
+    client = boto3.client("transcribe")
+    job_name = "tts-qa-" + audio_uri.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].replace(".", "-")
+    client.start_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=job_name, Media={"MediaFileUri": audio_uri}, MediaFormat=media_format, LanguageCode=language_code)
+    return job_name

+import speech_client
+
+
+def list_voices(locale: str | None = None):
+    voices = speech_client.supported_voices()
+    if not locale:
+        return voices
+    return [v for v in voices if v.get("LanguageCode") == locale or v.get("LanguageName", "").lower().startswith(locale.lower())]
+
+
+def select_voice(locale: str) -> str:
+    voices = list_voices(locale)
+    if voices:
+        return voices[0]["Id"]
+    return speech_client.tts_voice(locale)
